0|f07600cf9eb3ee92777b2001e564faa413144a99|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"USB: add reset_resume method
This patch (as918) introduces a new USB driver method: reset_resume.
It is called when a device needs to be reset as part of a resume
procedure (whether because of a device quirk or because of the
USB-Persist facility)
column2: thereby taking over a role formerly assigned to

column1: the post_reset method.  As a consequence
an argument indicating whether it is being called as part of a
reset-resume.  This separation of functions makes the code clearer.
In addition
column2: the pre_reset and post_reset method return types are

column1: changed; they now must return an error code.  The return value is
unused at present
column2: but at some later time we may unbind drivers and

column1: re-probe if they encounter an error during reset handling.
The existing pre_reset and post_reset methods in the usbhid
usb-storage
column2: and hub drivers are updated to match the new

column1: requirements.  For usbhid the post_reset routine is also used for
reset_resume (duplicate method pointers); for the other drivers a new
reset_resume routine is added.  The change to hub.c looks bigger than
it really is
next to the new hub_reset_resume() routine.
A minor change to usb-storage makes the usb_stor_report_bus_reset()
routine acquire the host lock instead of requiring the caller to hold
it already.
